gallery.title: File:Saltburn-by-the-Sea banner pier.jpg
gallery.description: I have been itching to go out and do a shoot for a while now. The equipment in my bag has been feeling underused, so this morning I got up at 5.30am and headed to the east coast. The weather looked promising, and I set my course for Saltburn-by-the-Sea, near Middlesbrough. The pier there is a favourite for togs, and I was hoping for some nice light. I was rewarded with some lovely pastel shades about 30 to 20 minutes before sunrise, and it was nice and quiet. Here's my first shot from on the pier itself.
